# Enterprise Agent Skills

> Vendor-neutral Agent Skills and plugins for enterprise platforms, with acceptance criteria and credential-free tests for every skill.

## Plugins

- [ABAP development skills for SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and SAP BTP](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/tree/main/plugins/sap-abap): Skills for SAP ABAP development across customer-managed and cloud systems: Standard ABAP on SAP ECC 6.0, SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP, and SAP S/4HANA (on premises or on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud VMs), enhancements and integration, plus ABAP Cloud with RAP and clean core assessments.
- [Lakehouse data engineering skills for Microsoft Fabric](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/tree/main/plugins/microsoft-fabric): Skills for data engineering in Microsoft Fabric: incremental, idempotent loads into Lakehouse Delta tables from notebooks, with secrets from Azure Key Vault and routine table maintenance. Bundles the read-only Microsoft Learn MCP server for current documentation.
- [Apex development skills for Salesforce](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/tree/main/plugins/salesforce-platform): Skills for Salesforce Platform development with Apex: bulk-safe trigger handlers, recursion control, user-mode data access, and tests that cover full 200-record trigger batches.

## Skills

- [sap-abap-standard](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/blob/main/plugins/sap-abap/skills/sap-abap-standard/SKILL.md): Write, fix, and review Standard ABAP for customer-managed SAP systems: SAP ECC 6.0, SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP, and SAP S/4HANA, on premises or on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud VMs. Covers reports and ALV, ABAP Objects, DDIC objects, ABAP SQL and HANA-aware performance, authorization checks, error handling, ABAP Unit, ATC, transports, and troubleshooting, using only syntax the target release supports.
- [sap-abap-enhancements](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/blob/main/plugins/sap-abap/skills/sap-abap-enhancements/SKILL.md): Choose and build enhancements of SAP standard code in Standard ABAP on SAP ECC 6.0 and SAP S/4HANA: Customizing first, then BAdIs and exits, modifications last. Covers kernel BAdIs (enhancement spots, filters, fallback classes, GET BADI, CALL BADI), classic BAdIs, customer exits (SMOD, CMOD), SD user exits such as MV45AFZZ, source code plug-ins, class and function module enhancements, LUW rules in exits, release limits from SAP_BASIS 7.00 to 8.16, SPAU and SPAU_ENH, and clean core levels.
- [sap-abap-integration](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/blob/main/plugins/sap-abap/skills/sap-abap-integration/SKILL.md): Write and review integration code in Standard ABAP on SAP ECC 6.0, SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP, and SAP S/4HANA: BAPI calls with RETURN checks and caller commit, BAPI-style RFC function modules, synchronous, asynchronous, and background RFC (tRFC, qRFC, bgRFC), IDocs with ALE and EDI, and SAP Gateway OData V2 services built in SEGW, using only syntax and APIs the target release supports.
- [sap-rap-business-object](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/blob/main/plugins/sap-abap/skills/sap-rap-business-object/SKILL.md): Build a managed RAP business object with draft for SAP Fiori elements on ABAP Cloud: database table, CDS view entities, behavior definition, behavior pool, projection layer, service definition, and service binding.
- [sap-clean-core-check](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/blob/main/plugins/sap-abap/skills/sap-clean-core-check/SKILL.md): Assess custom ABAP code for ABAP Cloud and clean core readiness: find SAP objects that are not released, look up their successors in SAP's Cloudification Repository, and rewrite code to use released APIs.
- [fabric-lakehouse-incremental-merge](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/blob/main/plugins/microsoft-fabric/skills/fabric-lakehouse-incremental-merge/SKILL.md): Load data incrementally into Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse Delta tables from a notebook with PySpark: watermark-based extraction, de-duplication, idempotent MERGE upserts, secrets from Azure Key Vault, and table maintenance.
- [salesforce-apex-trigger-framework](https://github.com/enterprise-agent-skills/enterprise-agent-skills/blob/main/plugins/salesforce-platform/skills/salesforce-apex-trigger-framework/SKILL.md): Implement Apex triggers with the one-trigger-per-object handler pattern: bulk-safe logic, recursion control that works across 200-record chunks, user-mode data access, field-level errors, and unit tests with full batches.
